settings.name_in_paper: Gaussian bandit with a Gaussian meta-prior (meta-learning over m tasks)
unmapped: Meta-learning: m sequential tasks of n rounds each; each task's instance theta_{s,*} ~ P_* = N(mu_*, sigma_0^2 I_K) i.i.d., with unknown instance-prior mean mu_* ~ Q = N(0, sigma_q^2 I_K); learner knows meta-prior Q, sigma_0, sigma but not P_*
Regret is the Bayes regret over the m tasks conditioned on P_* (summed over tasks)
settings.definition_quote: We consider a Gaussian bandit with $K$ arms that is parameterized by arm means $\theta \in \realset^K$. The reward of arm $i$ in instance $\theta$ is drawn i.i.d.\ from $\cN(\theta_i, \sigma^2)$. We have a continuum of instance priors, parameterized by a vector of means $\mu \in \realset^K$ and defined as $P(\theta) = \cN(\theta; \mu, \sigma_0^2 I_K)$. ... The meta-prior is a Gaussian distribution over instance prior means $Q(\mu) = \cN(\mu; \mathbf{0}, \sigma_q^2 I_K)$

settings.name_in_paper: K-armed Gaussian bandit with known Gaussian prior N(mu_*, sigma_0^2 I_K)
unmapped: Prior is Gaussian N(mu_*, sigma_0^2 I_K) with diagonal covariance
settings.definition_quote: Let $\theta_*$ be arm means in a $K$-armed Gaussian bandit that are generated as $\theta_* \sim P_* = \cN(\mu_*, \sigma_0^2 I_K)$.

bound.expression_latex: c_1 \sqrt{K} \left(\sqrt{n + \sigma^2 \sigma_0^{-2} K} - \sqrt{\sigma^2 \sigma_0^{-2} K}\right) m + c_2(\delta) c_3(\delta) K n^2 \sqrt{m} + \tilde{O}(K m + n)

symbols.sigma_0: standard deviation of the instance prior P_* = N(mu_*, sigma_0^2 I_K)
symbols.sigma_q: standard deviation of the meta-prior Q = N(0, sigma_q^2 I_K)

conditions: each task's instance drawn from P_* = N(mu_*, sigma_0^2 I_K), mu_* ~ N(0, sigma_q^2 I_K)
probability at least 1-(2m+1)delta over mu_*, theta_{s,*} and hat mu_s
tuning: each arm pulled once in the last K rounds of each task

source.label: thm:meta-ts regret bound
source.quote: The Bayes regret of \metats over $m$ tasks with $n$ rounds each is R(m, n; P_*) \leq c_1 \sqrt{K} (\sqrt{n + \sigma^2 \sigma_0^{-2} K} - \sqrt{\sigma^2 \sigma_0^{-2} K}) m + c_2(\delta) c_3(\delta) K n^2 \sqrt{m} + \tilde{O}(K m + n) with probability at least $1 - (2 m + 1) \delta$, where c_1 = 4 \sqrt{2 \sigma^2 \log n}, c_2(\delta) = 2 (\sqrt{2 \sigma_q^2 \log(2 K / \delta)} + \sqrt{2 \sigma_0^2 \log n}), c_3(\delta) = 8 \sqrt{(\sigma_0^2 + \sigma^2) \log(4 K / \delta) / (\pi \sigma_0^2)}.

results.notes: T denotes the per-task horizon n. Explicit leading terms with an additional O~(Km+n) term; recorded with O_tilde notation and that term written as K*m_tasks + T. Bayes regret conditioned on P_*, holding w.h.p. over the draw of mu_* etc.

bound.expression_latex: c(\delta) + 4 \sqrt{2 \sigma^2 K \log(1 / \delta)} \left(\sqrt{n + \sigma^2 \sigma_0^{-2} K} - \sqrt{\sigma^2 \sigma_0^{-2} K}\right), c(\delta) = 2 \sqrt{2 \sigma_0^2 \log(1 / \delta)} K + \sqrt{2 \sigma_0^2 / \pi} K n \delta

symbols.sigma_0: standard deviation of the Gaussian prior N(mu_*, sigma_0^2 I_K)
symbols.delta_free: any delta > 0, free analysis parameter (paper's delta)

source.label: lem:prior-dependent regret bound
source.quote: Let $\theta_*$ be arm means in a $K$-armed Gaussian bandit that are generated as $\theta_* \sim P_* = \cN(\mu_*, \sigma_0^2 I_K)$. Let $A_*$ be the optimal arm under $\theta_*$ and $A_t$ be the pulled arm in round $t$ by TS with prior $P_*$. Then for any $\delta > 0$, \E{\sum_{t = 1}^n \theta_*(A_*) - \theta_*(A_t)} \leq c(\delta) + 4 \sqrt{2 \sigma^2 K \log(1 / \delta)} (\sqrt{n + \sigma^2 \sigma_0^{-2} K} - \sqrt{\sigma^2 \sigma_0^{-2} K}), where $c(\delta) = 2 \sqrt{2 \sigma_0^2 \log(1 / \delta)} K + \sqrt{2 \sigma_0^2 / \pi} K n \delta$.

results.notes: Prior-dependent Bayes regret of TS; delta is a free parameter (e.g. 1/n gives O(sqrt(K n log n))).
